finding: The Layers panel had accessible move-up/down buttons but lacked the planned keyboard alternative for reordering. The existing Page Model hierarchy.reorder command and history can provide the same operation without adding a second mutation path.

details: Alt+ArrowUp and Alt+ArrowDown reorder exactly one selected layer through the existing hierarchy.reorder Page Model command and undo history.
Root, locked, locked-ancestor, boundary, and multi-selection cases cannot move; boundary cases are safe no-ops and multi-selection receives an explicit status message.
After a successful command, keyboard focus returns to the moved row and a status message communicates that Save is required.
Layer rows advertise shortcuts and their meaning to assistive technology. The versioned Editor app URL is cache-busted.
Save persists only the draft and survives reload; Publish is separately explicit and only then updates the published representation.

The exact-SHA Editor Core workflow failure on parent 20eb714 was traced to an outdated exact aria-keyshortcuts assertion after the keyboard-delete feature. The assertion now expects reorder and delete shortcuts too; its mobile and desktop cases pass locally.
change.third_party_code_or_dependency: NONE; reuses the existing hierarchy command, selection model, and history.

coverage: Accessible shortcut metadata and status announcement.
